name: perusall-collaborative-reading
description: Collaborative Reading App — Perusall Sr. Software Engineer Exercise

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.install:all: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd client && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../server && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
